languagePolicy: Russian and meaning-based English with equal visual prominence. No pronunciation or romanization layer.
indexConvention: All contributor indexes are zero-based within sourceTokens for the corresponding cueKey. No source or target timings are invented by this draft. Root will assign acoustic occurrence IDs after source inventory.
focusPolicy: English words activate over the union of their actual contributing source intervals. Do not replace a union with its bounding envelope. Russian events remain independently timed. Article, copula, auxiliary and phrasal expansions receive complete meaning focus, not permanently neutral grammar.

cues.refLine: В самой заброшенной, ветхой избушке рядом со мной будут не те
cues.englishText: In the most derelict, crumbling cottage, those next to me won’t be the same.
editorialNotes: Избушка is a small rustic cottage/hut. Рядом / со / мной retains next / to / me independently. The elliptical negative demonstrative не те is an expected-person identity contrast, made explicit as those next to me won’t be the same. Their relationship remains unnamed; no lover, family, strangers or moral judgment is supplied. Те carries the English subject those and the identity complement the same after grammatical recasting. The contraction won’t expresses future будут and negation не together, using their exact contributor union; be follows будут. This is a contextual meaning-based translation, not an author-certified wording.

Derelict renders the abandoned condition; crumbling is an ordinary English rendering of ветхий, indicating dilapidation rather than an animated collapse. Most retains самой. These shorter words protect equal lane size.

irreducibleConstructions.rationale: Won’t is an indivisible English contraction combining the future auxiliary in будут and explicit negation не. Focus uses only their interval union, preserving any real gap; the Russian words remain individually highlighted.

cueChunkPolicy: Suggested natural semantic reading units protect both language lanes at equal size; they do not dictate acoustic word timestamps.
